blanks: the 75 members asked on Tuesday evening
lines: Of the 75 members we asked, 36\% mainly swim laps. If they represent the pool, that is
about 540 of Harbor Point's 1,500 members --- an estimate, not a count.
Two different samples of 75 give two different statistics --- sampling variability, not a
counting error. There is exactly one true percent for all 1,500 members; both estimate it.
(1) Only 75 members were asked, on one Tuesday evening --- the sentence claims all 1,500.
(2) Nobody was asked about a second lane; the survey recorded what members mainly do.
